escena: SCENE (late-evening work session at his desk, a contemporary studio office with a floor-to-ceiling window over the city at blue hour): 85mm lens at f/2, chest-up, camera at desk height slightly to his left. Julio sits at a dark walnut desk in a charcoal crew-neck knit sweater, both forearms resting on the desk, leaning in a little, caught at the exact moment he looks down at the two small collectible figures standing on the desk in front of him — Clawd on the left and Codex on the right, about 25 cm tall each, facing him. His head tilts only slightly down; his eyes are lowered toward the figures but stay clearly open: each iris a full circle, white visible on both sides, upper eyelid above the iris with its own crease. A relaxed, CLOSED-MOUTH half smile of amusement — no teeth, no squint, cheeks relaxed, nothing pressing on his face; his hands rest on the desk, away from his face. A current-generation laptop with a thin bezel is open at the right edge, its screen turned away. THE WHOLE FRAME IS COOL AND CONTEMPORARY: the key light is a large soft daylight-balanced panel from the left, the city window behind is deep blue hour; nothing is warm, amber, orange or golden; no tungsten, no retro glow, practical lamps OFF. The only warm note in the frame is Clawd's own terracotta body. Shadows neutral, never blue-tinted on skin. Everything unbranded except the two figures; no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the dark walnut desk, out of focus right against the lens, spanning the full width of the bottom of the frame
lecho.tono: DARK near black, matte, no highlights
